summary: Created cards from the Oracle Proxy scans (issue 387): a general resolver (AbilityDefinition.Creates spec -> the published CreatedOnly scan that fits, CreatedCards.Resolve/Verify, ExecuteCreate for Personalities and attached Items/Followers/Spells, OncePerGame, created cards never left in a pile). Lion Ancestor, Ohsuki's Sparrow and Tokoru's Bear re-expressed through it unchanged; Bo of Water (spell-wave-10) and Water Bo (item-wave-5) wired end to end; created-only scans excluded from the deck workshop, match setup, published decks and playable-from-decks counts. Survey and proposed pairings (61 Proxy scans, 105 creator cards) with questions for Mendon in docs/decisions/2026-09-20-created-cards-from-proxy-scans.md. Shared lane: rules engine plus deck workshop, content pipeline and shipped card art; no UI logic changed.
validation: bash tools/check.sh --skip-client (see PR for exact counts); new suite created-cards 13/13; 11 mutations each fail a named test; no scan downloaded (Water Bo and Bo of Water scans already in the local cache, sha256 match the committed receipts).
remaining: Mendon's answers to the 14 questions in the decision note; then wiring the remaining paired creators is scan waves plus Creates specs. Not built: created Holdings/Regions/Strategies, counts, per-instance stats/alignment/title, copy creators.
